hero.forge2k.cyb_deckard2k.biography: Deckard's state-of-the-art heavy armor fully lives up to its expectations. The mere sight of this impregnable cyborg on the battlefield can fill his troops with strength to weather the onslaught of bullets and blows.
hero.forge2k.cyb_deckard2k.name: Deckard
hero.forge2k.cyb_deckard2k.specialty.des: Receives a 7% per level bonus to Armorer skill percentage.
hero.forge2k.cyb_flamius2k.biography: When Kastore's troops began plundering vaults and ruins of the Ancients, Gogs, often inhabiting such areas, started joining the Heavenly Forge army. Flamius' skill with the advanced weaponry was leagues above his fellow kin, and he was more than eager to teach them the advantages of cybernetic enhancements.
hero.forge2k.cyb_flamius2k.name: Flamius
hero.forge2k.cyb_flamius2k.specialty.des: Increases the speed of Pyros or Pyromaniacs by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 3 levels (rounded up).
hero.forge2k.cyb_jules2k.biography: Even before the reactivation of the Heavenly Forge, Jules had always yearned to traverse the skies. Other Minotaurs called him crazy. Who's crazy now?
hero.forge2k.cyb_jules2k.name: Jules
hero.forge2k.cyb_jules2k.specialty.descr: Increases the speed of Jump Cadets or Jump Soldiers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.forge2k.cyb_jules2k.specialty.name: Jump Cadets
hero.forge2k.cyb_null2k.name: Null
hero.forge2k.cyb_null2k.specialty.descri: Increases the speed of Juggernauts or Dreadnoughts by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.forge2k.cyb_null2k.specialty.name: Juggernauts
hero.forge2k.cyb_rengust2k.biography: The kin to the late king Boragus, Rengust joined the quickly expanding Deyjan empire, in hope to turn the miraculous inventions of the Heavenly Forge into the tools of his vengeance.
hero.forge2k.cyb_rengust2k.name: Rengust
hero.forge2k.cyb_rengust2k.specialty.des: Increases the speed of Stingers or Bruisers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.forge2k.cyb_singhell2k.biography: Singhell was above average in terms of abilities among Living Dead, yet it was only after he received the blessing of the Heavenly Forge, that he reached his full potential. Cybernetic enhancements allowed him to assume a role of an outstanding commander.
hero.forge2k.cyb_singhell2k.name: Singhell
hero.forge2k.cyb_singhell2k.specialty.de: Increases the speed of Cyber Dead or Cyber Zombies by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
hero.forge2k.cyb_sprinter2k.biography: First of the Krewlod's Goblin leaders to embrace the abominable technomancy. The lure of the lethal weaponry and monstrous raids was just too enticing.
hero.forge2k.cyb_sprinter2k.name: Sprinter
hero.forge2k.cyb_sprinter2k.specialty.de: Increases the speed of Grunts or Troopers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills for each level attained after 1st level.
hero.forge2k.cyb_sturm2k.biography: A cruel warlord, who quickly rose in ranks thanks to his destructive skills and thirst for power. Some say that he plans to overthrow Kastore himself one day.
hero.forge2k.cyb_sturm2k.name: Sturm
hero.forge2k.cyb_sturm2k.specialty.descr: Always casts Meteor Shower at expert level, and with slightly increased effect (1% per hero level / target creature tier).
hero.forge2k.cyb_sturm2k.specialty.name: Meteor Shower
hero.forge2k.cyb_sunnith2k.biography: Sunnith and her band of renegade Nagas led the lives of fugitives after defying their Bracadan masters. With their tails bruised and torn from the long years of roaming, she and her sisters have finally found a safe haven in the embrace of steel and circuits.
hero.forge2k.cyb_sunnith2k.name: Sunnith
hero.forge2k.cyb_sunnith2k.specialty.des: Increases the speed of Tanks or Heavy Tanks by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 6 levels (rounded up).
hero.forge2k.tp_agar2k.biography: The rumours of Master Agar's demise were greatly exaggerated... well, not exactly. Despite having been slain in Enroth, this tenacious Lich appeared under various guises throughout the land, not unlike a certain Immortal Hero. Some strange magic must be at play.
hero.forge2k.tp_agar2k.name: Agar
hero.forge2k.tp_agar2k.specialty.descrip: Resurrection raises target stack with additional 50 Health and with slightly increased effect (1% per level / target creature tier).
hero.forge2k.tp_agar2k.specialty.name: Resurrection
hero.forge2k.tp_charity2k.biography: After the Succession Wars, Charity left the continent of Enroth, lusting after more excitement and conflict. Eventually, she was attracted to the roaring call of the Heavenly Forge, like a moth drawn to the flame.
hero.forge2k.tp_charity2k.name: Charity
hero.forge2k.tp_charity2k.specialty.desc: Receives a 7% per level bonus to Sorcery skill percentage.
hero.forge2k.tp_charity2k.specialty.name: Sorcery
hero.forge2k.tp_cistrict2k.biography: Cistrict's abilities and great ambition brought upon him the wrath of many Nighon Warlocks. When the Heavenly Forge blazed anew, he found himself before its gates, to seek restoration of the body ravaged by magic duels.
hero.forge2k.tp_cistrict2k.name: Cistrict
hero.forge2k.tp_cistrict2k.specialty.des: Receives a 7% per level bonus to Resistance skill percentage.
hero.forge2k.tp_elthas2k.biography: Elthas made his name when he developed extremely efficient means of blowing up large swaths of land. This made it easier to access buried vaults of the Ancients and a wealth of underground resources, so ravenously consumed by the furnaces of the Heavenly Forge.
hero.forge2k.tp_elthas2k.name: Elthas
hero.forge2k.tp_elthas2k.specialty.descr: Casts Inferno with 50 additional damage and with slightly increased effect (1% per hero level / target creature tier).
hero.forge2k.tp_elthas2k.specialty.name: Inferno
hero.forge2k.tp_everest2k.biography: Everest was banished from Bracada for taking over wizads' golems and other animated servants. In the more turbulent circles of Techno Junkies, his impulses stopped sparking controversy, allowing him to perfect the art of controlling magical constructs.
hero.forge2k.tp_everest2k.name: Everest
hero.forge2k.tp_everest2k.specialty.desc: Receives a 10% per level bonus to Mysticism skill.
hero.forge2k.tp_everest2k.specialty.name: Mysticism
hero.forge2k.tp_kastore2k.biography: Kastore is a powerful sorcerer who knows many secrets of the Ancients. He plans to conquer the world and will stop at nothing in pursuit of this goal.
hero.forge2k.tp_kastore2k.name: Kastore
hero.forge2k.tp_kastore2k.specialty.desc: Knows a special Clone spell variant which costs more spell points and summons 2 clones of the target unit.
hero.forge2k.tp_kastore2k.specialty.name: Double Clone
hero.forge2k.tp_leanne2k.biography: For a Deyjan countrygirl like Leanne, the greatest possible prospect in life was to become a rich necromancer's maid. However, Kastore's coup brought about a new order, and now, with a deadly blaster in hand, the world is her oyster.
hero.forge2k.tp_leanne2k.name: Leanne
hero.forge2k.tp_leanne2k.specialty.descr: Casts Lightning Bolt with 50 additional damage and with slightly increased effect (1% per hero level / target creature tier).
hero.forge2k.tp_leanne2k.specialty.name: Lightning Bolt
hero.forge2k.tp_sheikleen2k.biography: Enigmas like Sheikleen are not uncommon in the ranks of the Heavenly Forge. She emerged one day within the chain of command and her directives won battles, so she was universally deemed a useful asset. Still, there's always an ulterior motive with these kinds of people.
hero.forge2k.tp_sheikleen2k.name: Sheikleen
hero.forge2k.tp_sheikleen2k.specialty.de: Receives a 10% per level bonus to Intelligence skill percentage.
